signals: lane A exactly as engine/of_paper.replay_summary (DESIGN_paper.md): taken = absorbed and not busy; skipped tracked

entry.fill_rule: marketable at first open, else >= 1 tick through the level; stop touched first = no trade
entry.fallback: market at open of minute 6 + 18 ticks against us
entry.stop: 1 tick beyond the signal bar extreme

path: data/NQ_1m.csv + day median offset when covered, else the day's 5m summary bars

frozen.why: best tested variant: YES-candidate, most $ at 1 micro, beat 2R in both halves

frozen.target: nearest opposite-type level (short at a high-type -> pdl/onl/orl; long -> pdh/onh/orh) known at the signal bar, >= 1R in profit, limit 2 ticks in front; none -> 2R
frozen.why: next by the freeze rule and a different kind

oos_pass_bar: per frozen variant: n >= 30, mean R > 0 and $ > 0 in both OOS halves, label-shuffle placebo p < 0.05, Holm (2 frozen) < 0.10; 'exit edge' also needs net $ > B2R in both OOS halves
